description: Build a robust HTTP client layer with retry logic and error handling
steps: Create src/prediction_data/core/http.py with httpx async client wrapper
Implement exponential backoff with jitter for retries
Configure retry on 429 (rate limit), 503, and transient 5xx errors
Configure retry on network/connection errors
Add configurable timeout settings (connect, read, total)
Add request/response logging with timing metrics

description: Implement run_id generation and tracking for idempotent ingestion
steps: Create src/prediction_data/core/run.py with RunContext dataclass
Implement UUID4 run_id generation
Include run_id in all log messages via structlog binding
Create helper to format run_id for S3 keys
Add run start/end timestamp tracking

description: Build S3 storage layer following the Bronze storage contract
steps: Create src/prediction_data/storage/s3.py with S3Client class
Implement method to build S3 key path: bronze/{platform}/{entity}/dt={dt}/run_id={run_id}/
Implement gzip compression for JSONL content
Implement upload_jsonl method that writes part-000.jsonl.gz
Implement upload_manifest method that writes manifest.json
Add validation that keys match expected Bronze layout pattern

description: Define and implement the manifest.json contract
steps: Create src/prediction_data/storage/manifest.py with Manifest pydantic model
Define all required fields: run_id, platform, entity, dt, generated_at, files, row_count, source
Define nested Source model with api_base_url, pagination, cursor fields
Define nested FileReference model with bucket, key fields
Implement manifest serialization to JSON with ISO-8601 timestamps
Add manifest validation on load

description: Implement compression and file format utilities
steps: Create src/prediction_data/core/compression.py with gzip utilities
Implement streaming gzip compression for large datasets
Implement JSONL serialization (one JSON object per line)
Add row counting during serialization
Ensure UTF-8 encoding throughout

description: Add unit tests for core infrastructure components
steps: Create tests/test_http.py with mock-based HTTP client tests
Create tests/test_run.py with run_id generation tests
Create tests/test_s3.py with moto-based S3 tests
Create tests/test_manifest.py with manifest serialization tests
Create tests/test_compression.py with gzip/JSONL tests
Verify all tests pass with pytest
